# Yantratech Solutions

> Pan-India supplier of industrial testing and measuring instruments, process calibrators, thermal imaging cameras, electrical switchgears, and digital panel meters.

Yantratech Solutions supplies 100% genuine industrial instrumentation to manufacturing plants, power utilities, refineries, chemical processors, and EPC contractors across India. Headquartered in Titwala / Mumbai, Maharashtra, we offer full manufacturer warranties, NABL-traceable calibration certificates, technical product selection assistance, and pan-India express delivery.

- [Products Taxonomy](https://www.yantratechsolutions.co.in/products): Full range across 8 core categories: Testing & Measuring, Safety Accessories, Calibration, Process Instruments, Thermal Imaging, Panel Meters, Switchgears, and Industrial Tools.
- [Authorized Brands](https://www.yantratechsolutions.co.in/brands): Certified distribution and sourcing for Fluke, FLIR, Kyoritsu, Rishabh Instruments, Selec Controls, and GW Instek.
- [Industries We Serve](https://www.yantratechsolutions.co.in/industries): Application solutions for Automobile, Chemical, FMCG, Cement, Power, Manufacturing, Oil & Gas, and Pharmaceuticals.
- [Why Choose Yantratech](https://www.yantratechsolutions.co.in/why-us): Value guarantees including genuine OEM warranty, competitive pricing, NABL calibration support, and express delivery.
